candidates.idea: Check actual listed task terminal states and artifact references, not only completed labels
candidates.benefit: Reject false completion and provide recoverable diagnostics
candidates.experiment: Same 19 independently prepared CLI/API cases; old 6/19, new 19/19; retain six valid controls

candidates.idea: Bind acceptance to a consumer-owned request and input version; detect omitted required work/stale outputs
candidates.benefit_hypothesis: Listed-task consistency does not catch omitted tasks or arbitrary input_version
candidates.cost: Moderate; check producer/consumer contract before changing interface
candidates.minimum_experiment: Keep artifact bytes constant, mutate request version or omit one required task; consumer must reject mismatches while accepting independent historical work. Use new held-out cross-role inputs.
candidates.measured_result: Same16 synthetic structural cases:baseline8/16,candidate16/16;12 new scope tests,all352 regression tests344passed8skipped. No model effect-size claim.
candidates.remaining: Consumer provenance/semantic task acceptance and independently fixed dependency edges remain host responsibilities; no model handoff rerun this follow-up.

candidates.idea: Measure repeated complete-task reliability separately from best-of-k recovery
candidates.benefit_hypothesis: Single successful role examples do not establish reliability
candidates.cost: Need pinned model/tool/inputs and bounded repeated-run budget
candidates.minimum_experiment: Pre-register 3 fresh cross-role tasks and 3 trials per version; report all outcomes and pass^k only for k<=n. Do not use deterministic validator repeats as model reliability.

candidates.idea: Measure streaming artifact hashing and large-DAG validation cost before optimizing
candidates.benefit_hypothesis: read_bytes loads entire artifacts; iterative elimination repeatedly scans a chain
candidates.cost: Small, but profile representative artifacts first
candidates.minimum_experiment: Compare peak memory/time on bounded synthetic large artifacts and DAGs with identical validation decisions; no speculative performance claim.

candidates.idea: Bound host execution, actual artifact grading and fixed denominator in a lightweight pipeline
candidates.minimum_experiment: Program negative controls plus all-role real host smoke; distinguish execution from correctness
candidates.measured_result: 25/25 program acceptance controls; 19 effective host model cases independently accepted, including 14 roles. No model success-rate improvement or cost gain claimed.

candidates.idea: Evidence-driven bounded repair, retain first/final and wrong-edit rate
candidates.minimum_experiment: Same-budget current/retry/feedback three-arm test with heldout final checks

candidates.idea: Measure selective Skill loading before reducing mirrored reference content
candidates.minimum_experiment: Same task/model; trace loaded files and hard constraints; unknown token metrics remain unknown

candidates.idea: Promote workflow memories only after independent acceptance and heldout regression
candidates.minimum_experiment: Separate extraction from frozen evaluation; stale tool and false-success counterexamples

candidates.idea: Measure task utility and forbidden side effects separately
candidates.minimum_experiment: Paired clean/contaminated synthetic inputs, final artifacts and action trace; no real external side effects

candidates.idea: Versioned source-linked memory; user-intent correction marks downstream interpretations stale and gates execution/acceptance
candidates.experiment: Same eight deterministic synthetic ReportingHandler acceptance cases: baseline3/8 candidate8/8; raw bytes preserved. One fresh code-organization correction handoff inspected independently.

candidates.source: User requested artifact lifecycle; research synthesis RV-01/RV-02
candidates.idea: Reuse parameterized scripts and publish immutable run report snapshots through an atomic stable pointer with hash/memory checks
candidates.experiment: 13 tests including concurrent same/different run IDs, latest failure preservation, symlinks, immutable snapshots, changed data and corrected memory

candidates.idea: First-to-final correct_to_wrong and wrong_to_correct reporting with independently graded binary endpoints
candidates.experiment: 40 pipeline tests; graded regression/recovery, mock, ungradable, blocked and tamper boundaries

candidates.idea: Numeric fidelity hard gate plus bounded independent visual comparison and rollback
candidates.minimum_experiment: Six unseen data tasks, fixed arrays/transforms/size, blinded before/after reviewer; record visual preference separately from exact numeric fidelity and negative examples. No whole-agent beauty claim before repeated paired runs.

candidates.idea: Automatically generated versioned retrieval indexes with task-relevant context paging
candidates.minimum_experiment: Same model and token/retrieval budget; frozen correction, historical lookup and abstention cases. Compare manual deps versus generated recall links. Generated similarity must not become causal dependencies.
candidates.reason: Source preservation and explicit deps implemented first; automatic semantic linking/reorganization not shown locally beneficial.

candidates.idea: Verifiable intermediate artifacts and scientific acceptance separate from self-review scores
candidates.minimum_experiment: Same-model corrected-intent holdouts and research claims with wrong units, metric direction, leakage and incomplete runs; report false acceptance, correct-to-wrong, abstention and cost. Do not interpret external workflow as PRM training.

candidates.idea: Check that file-reorganization proposals include path-specific, executable rollback or an explicit reason no mutation is permitted, rather than a bare promise of a rollback point
candidates.minimum_experiment: Freeze two unseen projects (Git-enabled stopped outputs and unknown/non-Git consumers), compare current wording versus concrete rollback requirements in fresh contexts. Verify original files unchanged and no unsafe checkout/reset/delete instructions. Preserve both initial failure and feedback recovery.
candidates.reason: This round discovered a real first-attempt omission; a feedback-assisted retry is not evidence that a prompt patch generalizes.
